notes.title: Discover Love Menu
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41239321/49b0f63ebc062f9257a6436036633b4b1c672c5f.png[/img]

Hey Steam Community!

Introducing "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262370/Love_Menu/]Love Menu[/url]", a delightful visual novel by our friends at Love Quest Studio. This sweet and spicy journey, although a short story, features stunning art, engaging characters, and a captivating narrative that will sweep you off your feet!

Love Menu's mix of tender romance and tempting twists creates an enchanting experience. Immerse yourself in this beautifully crafted world and make choices that impact the story, leading you to a heartwarming conclusion.

Don't miss out on Love Menu, now available on Steam! Add it to your Wishlist and let love spice up your gaming!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2262370/Love_Menu/
